author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang. Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam: -Character Design & Illustration -Character Sprites -Background & Environment Art -Webtoon / Comic Artwork -Game & Digital Art Assets -Ilustrasi dan visual development lainnya. Kualifikasi include strong portfolio, ability to follow art direction, meet deadlines. Cara Melamar: send portfolio and intro to avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com with subject Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]. Include art types, style, availability, rate.

author: Sealious Seal
title: LF people who can draw Pokemon
content: LF people who can draw Pokemon. You don’t have to be a Pokemon-centered artist or anything, I just want artists who are willing to draw Pokemon or know how 😭 more specifically, Garchomp and Lucario. I usually prefer more anime-esque styles and the OC is cutesy and elegant, but given the Pokemon, I can’t be picky this time around when it comes to the style ,, place your rates and samples in the comments, NO DMS! This is the OC (credit to Miki Fleur) and she will be wearing more fashionable clothes (similar to Emma from Veil) so please be able to draw those too! MOP: GCash, like always.

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST.
